title: Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku
overview:
There's as much HAPPY as there are friends.

Sure, you might fight once in a while, but in the end, the ones you can count on are fun friends you get along with. Things you can't do alone go well when everyone does them together. What matters is how many wonderful relationships you can build. So, surrounded by lots of friends, let's spend some wonderful time together.

A young drifter who has always been alone arrives in Enfield, a town rebuilt after a war fifty years ago. Taken in by Arisa, the widow who runs a general store, he finally finds kindness - until he is arrested for a crime he did not commit. Arisa pays to free him, and now he has one year to repay her, win back the town's trust to earn a retrial, and find the real culprit.

In this friendship-building simulation, recruit three companions, choose odd jobs at the start of each week and assign them to your team. Spend weekends training skills or getting to know the townsfolk, and decide who you will share your happy ending with.

- 1 player

仲間の数だけ、HAPPYがある。

そりゃまぁ、たまにはケンカもするだろうけど、結局たよりになるのは、気の合う楽しい仲間だよね。一人じゃできないことも、みんなでやればうまくいくじゃない。大切なのは、どれだけステキな関係が築けるかってこと。さ、大勢の仲間に囲まれて、ステキな時間をすごそうよ
